QuestInfo.name: [Legends] Warm in the Ice
QuestInfo.0: Gaga is freezing! You should help him survive the winter.
QuestInfo.1: #i3994381##b Legendary Igloo#k\n\nGaga needs you to hold onto this igloo in your Set-up inventory until it's ready. Even though it's made of ice, it's perfectly warm inside. It should be ready for Gaga in about 30 minutes.
QuestInfo.2: You fixed up the Legendary Igloo and gave it to Gaga. Hopefully the poor guy can get himself warmed up.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP based on level #i02001544# x 30 #i4310027##t4310027# x 1 (maximum of 4 per day)
